audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 print Gragas in both layers while whys[1] says "Level 2 stays even" and whys[2] says "Level 3 remains a skill check where dodging Barrel Roll keeps it neutral".
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill x5 then Gragas, Gragas, and the mirror audit records that exact sequence applied as one atomic group. The page currently names a winner above prose that says there isn't one.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 set to Skill in both layers as matched pairs. Rows 0, 3, 4, 5, 6 already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is named the matchup-defining cooldown in eleven fields and its duration appears nowhere.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — the same 14s as Zaahen's own W, so neither of you gets a free second engage in one wave. Barrel Roll is 10/9/8/7/6 at 80 mana, Drunken Rage a flat 5s, Explosive Cask 100/85/70 against Grim Deliverance's 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Body Slam's 14s, Barrel Roll's 10s and 80 mana, Drunken Rage's 5s and Explosive Cask's 100s written into the phases, spikes and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) "Golden Onslaught" is not a Zaahen ability — the E is Aureate Rush (two fields). (b) "Final Retribution" is not his R — it is Grim Deliverance. (c) Drunken Rage is an auto-attack reset and nothing said so. (d) Happy Hour heals him on skill use and the content layer never mentions anti-heal, though report[8] already buys it.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both the anti-heal and the auto-reset. The reset matters more than it looks: Drunken Rage is a flat 5s, so the W wind-up is a tell you will see repeatedly every wave, and stepping back on the cast rather than the wind-up means eating it every time. Happy Hour healing on every cast is why his Barrel Roll poke costs him less than the page implies.
audit.corrected: Real names restored, the Drunken Rage wind-up named as the step-back cue, and Grievous Wounds tied to Happy Hour in the late/first-item text where the extended trade lives.

audit.why: packet.defects flags "His Explosive Cask" in spikes[1] as a probable wrong name at distance 4. That is a false positive — Explosive Cask is the real R name and the flagged distance is just the leading word "His".
audit.corrected: No name change made on that basis; the string was rewritten for other reasons.

notes: packet.defects flagged "His Explosive Cask" as a probable wrong ability name — it is a false positive, Explosive Cask is correct. The genuine fabrications were on Zaahen's own side again: 'Golden Onslaught' (Aureate Rush) and 'Final Retribution' (Grim Deliverance), the same pair the mirror found and the same pair now seen in gangplank, garen and gnar. QUESTION deferred rather than guessed: whys[4] claims Explosive Cask "can cancel your R". Nothing in the kit marks Grim Deliverance as a channel or interruptible, so I rewrote spikes[1] to say the knockback displaces you out of its 600 range — which is verifiable — and left whys[4] untouched rather than assert an interrupt I cannot confirm.
